rss.title: 1 bullet vs 5 objects — how far does it go? 😳 #shorts
rss.desc:
One .308 rifle bullet (9.7 g, 850 m/s, 3,500 J) vs 5 objects in a row. Real physics, slow motion up to ×16,000:

1 Watermelon 25 cm → 850 → 710 m/s
2 Tempered glass 6 mm → 710 → 650 m/s
3 Block of ice 20 cm → 650 → 536 m/s
4 Pine board 5 cm → 536 → 514 m/s
5 AR500 steel 10 mm → STOPPED (1,282 J left, ~2,550 J needed)

Did you guess where it stops? 👀
